_comment: The payoff was a second ability triggered on ON_BANISH, which is not a trigger name -- dispatch falls back to the raw string and matches nothing, so it never ran. 'Whenever THIS banishes' means the banish this card just did, so it is a CONDITIONAL in the SAME ability, reading the `banished` ref BANISH now records. No new engine event needed. 'Another card with the same NAME' was written as REF_PITCH_IS pitch:1. Pitch 1 is red; it has nothing to do with names.
